dedupe_keys.name: afryka postmining lake bathymetric point cloud

description: RepOD publishes raw bathymetric soundings from the Afryka postmining lake in western Poland. The named provider page lists 6,538 points acquired in November 2023 with an unmanned surface vessel and a Satlab SLD 200 echosounder, supplied as a LAS point cloud with a preview image. It states CC0 1.0 and shows public file links without a fee. The point cloud can define lakebed geometry for mine-lake circulation, sediment or slope-stability simulations. It is a single survey, not a continuous depth-change record or proof that submerged slopes remain stable. Sounding spacing, vertical datum and interpolation choices must be checked before turning it into a model mesh. The provider links a separate underwater terrain-model dataset, whose own page was not reachable in this review. It complements data-mexico-basin-hydrogeological-units as local measured geometry, not interpreted regional subsurface units. No LAS file was downloaded. A limitation is that a single November survey cannot show later erosion or lakebed change.
